conclusion: The sole acquisition completed all 400 non-warm windows, but seven family comparisons had opposite ABBA/BAAB median perturbation signs and five family duration intervals exceeded the 5 us/token uncertainty gate. The only family passing all measurement gates, moe_wrapper, times required sparse graph work rather than isolated removable overhead. No successor is nominated.

design.perturbation_estimand: Within every order/round, nearest measured-control complete-wall pairs are p1-p0 and p2-p3 for ABBA, and p0-p1 and p3-p2 for BAAB. The robust order effect is the median of ten pair effects.
design.probe_estimand: For each measured window, sum elapsed DispatchTime intervals at the selected family, subtract count times calibrated empty timer cost, and divide by 128 tokens. Nested useful work and dependency exposure remain inside broad timed boundaries.

uncertainty_method.seed: first eight SHA-256 bytes of family name, big-endian
